title: Covariance Identification from Regression Residuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.41722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regression residuals are projections of the errors, not observations of them. This paper characterizes what residuals identify about the error covariance. Residualization acts on the covariance through a known linear map, and under an unrestricted covariance model the directions it destroys are exactly those generated by the column space of the regressors. A linear covariance functional is identified if and only if it does not load on these lost directions, and restricting the covariance model, for instance to diagonal or clustered form, shrinks them. The central result separates projection loss from moment-selection loss: projecting the residual covariance onto the maintained covariance structure loses no identifying information, so cross-cluster, long-lag, and long-distance residual products add no identifying directions. translated_title: 从回归残差中进行协方差识别
translated_abstract: 回归残差是误差的投影，而非对误差的观测。本文刻画了残差能够识别出误差协方差的哪些信息。残差化通过一个已知的线性映射作用于协方差，在无约束的协方差模型下，它所破坏的方向恰好是由回归变量列空间生成的方向。一个线性协方差泛函可被识别，当且仅当它不加载在这些丢失的方向上；而对协方差模型施加限制（例如对角形式或聚类形式）则会缩小这些丢失方向。本文的核心结果将投影损失与矩选择损失区分开来：将残差协方差投影到所维持的协方差结构上不会损失任何识别信息，因此跨聚类、长滞后和远距离的残差乘积不会增加识别方向。不过它们仍能改善条件数，因为限制到对齐的矩会使条件数变为平方。
tldr: 本文刻画了回归残差对误差协方差的识别能力，核心结论是投影损失与矩选择损失可以分离：将残差协方差投影到所维持的协方差结构上不损失任何识别信息，因此跨聚类、长滞后和远距离的残差乘积不增加识别方向，但可以改善条件数。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes what regression residuals identify about the error covariance, showing that projection loss is separate from moment-selection loss: projecting the residual covariance onto the maintained covariance structure loses no identifying information, so cross-cluster, long-lag, and long-distance residual products add no identifying directions, though they can improve conditioning.
